entities.summary: Bolshevik, a notable figure in the history of Azerbaijan, associated with Democratic Republic and Sovietization (1918–1920). Preceded by Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and Red Army invades and sovietizes Azerbaijan. Their legacy influenced March Days and Ethnic Conflict.
